implementation.name: original-v3-checkpoint-consistent-cut
implementation.scope: Illustrative boundaries r18 and r17 on the original compatible-cut and torn-pair panels. c0 is already published; c1 is the attempted new checkpoint. The case selector chooses alternatives, not successive states of one pair. Pending test_r18 and its reservation survive recovery.
implementation.question: When may a new checkpoint replace an earlier recovery cut?

purpose: Show referenced payload becoming durable before manifest publication, while an older recovery cut and unresolved obligations survive.
storyboard: Publish only a durable compatible cut
Select a cut after a crash
guard: A recovery cut must preserve compatible record and workspace payloads plus the retained suffix needed for replay. A torn pair is rejected. Replay folds recorded state; it neither repeats external effects nor settles an unknown tool outcome.
